Start a session on this issue
The session reads the issue, implements it on
a branch of its own and opens a pull request
closing it. It runs a paid agent on this
Closes it on GitHub, as completed or as not
planned, with a comment first if you write
Successfully merging this pull request may
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
Header buttons are icon-only: Copy the issue’s link, then Read the issue from GitHub again (⟳). The subtitle adds "· list retry after <time>" when the board is rate-limited.

Close issue ▾ opens a menu: Close as completed, Close as not planned, then a separator, then Close as completed with a comment… and Close as not planned with a comment…. The comment variants open a "Comment on #470 before closing
it" dialog (Next). Every choice then asks "Close issue #470 as completed?" and names any open sub-issues or a running session.
Once closed, a box at the top reads "Closed as completed" (or "Closed as not planned") with "It has left the board. Reopen it on GitHub if it was closed by mistake." The Actions section is hidden.
On an epic, Start is replaced with a caption saying that an orchestrator works an epic and it has to be started from the web dashboard.
Two columns appear at 880px of content or more. The sidebar takes 26% (240 to 320px). Narrower windows stack the sidebar under the main column.
On the board it opens as an overlay side panel (app_set_overlay). From a PR or an issue row it is pushed as a screen.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
